tasks.name: Lighting Plan
tasks.objective: Produce the Lighting Plan for this project, meeting every acceptance criterion, then submit it for Studio Director review.
acceptance: Key, fill and rim intent defined per time of day and biome
Shadow strategy and cascade distances stated with numbers
Post-processing stack listed with cost estimates

tasks.name: Lighting and Post Setup
tasks.objective: Produce the Lighting and Post Setup for this project, meeting every acceptance criterion, then submit it for Studio Director review.
acceptance: Lightmaps or probes baked and stored with the scene
Day/night interpolation verified across a full cycle
Every lighting feature has a documented quality tier

tasks.name: Lighting Performance Review
tasks.objective: Produce the Lighting Performance Review for this project, meeting every acceptance criterion, then submit it for Studio Director review.
acceptance: Frame cost of lighting and post measured per quality tier
Shadow and probe memory measured against the profile budget
Lowest tier verified playable on the weakest declared device
